<h2 id="mcpmodel-context-protocol模型上下文协议">MCP（Model Context Protocol）模型上下文协议</h2>
<p>MCP：标准化了应用程序如何像LLM提供上下文。提供了一种<strong>标准化的方式将AI模型连接到不同的数据源和工具</strong>。</p>
<p>可以将MCP想象成AI应用的USB-C端口，USB-C提供了标准化方式将设备连接到外围设备，MCP提供一种标准化方式将AI模型连接到不同的数据源和工具。</p>
<p>解决多个大模型调用同一个外部工具的需求。</p>
<p><img alt="无标题20" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3388489/202611/3388489-20261109173754528-1470231606.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="无标题21" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3388489/202611/3388489-20261109173800867-1353648240.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="无标题18" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3388489/202611/3388489-20261109173807642-1159849503.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><a href="https://mcp.so/zh" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">MCP.so - MCP 应用市场</a></p>
<p>MCP的两种协议，一般使用STDIO。因为是双向流</p>
<p><img alt="无标题19" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3388489/202611/3388489-20261109173817117-534759736.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="mcp架构">MCP架构</h2>
<p>MCP主机：发起请求的AI程序，比如聊天机器人</p>
<p>MCP客户端：在主机程序内部，与MCP服务器保持1：1的连接</p>
<p>MCP服务器：为MCP客户端提供上下文、工具和提示信息。</p>
<p>本地资源：本地计算机中可供MCP服务器安全访问的资源，如文件</p>
<p>远程资源：MCP服务器可以远程连接到的资源，如通过API提供的数据。</p>
<p>开发者只需写一次MCP服务，所有兼容MCP协议模型都能调用，MCP让大模型从“被动应答”变为“主动调用工具”。</p>
<p>调用一个MCP服务器，就等价调用了带有多个功能的utils工具类。</p>
<h2 id="代码演示">代码演示</h2>
<h3 id="mcp服务端">MCP服务端</h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p>pom依赖</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">&lt;dependencies&gt;
    &lt;dependency&gt;
        &lt;groupId&gt;org.springframework.boot&lt;/groupId&gt;
        &lt;artifactId&gt;spring-boot-starter&lt;/artifactId&gt;
    &lt;/dependency&gt;
    &lt;!--spring-ai-starter-mcp-server-webflux 不能和spring-boot-starter-web 依赖并存，
    否则会使用tomcat启动而不是netty。从而导致mcpserver启动失败。但程序正常运行，mcp客户端连不上--&gt;
    &lt;dependency&gt;
        &lt;groupId&gt;org.springframework.ai&lt;/groupId&gt;
        &lt;artifactId&gt;spring-ai-starter-mcp-server-webflux&lt;/artifactId&gt;
    &lt;/dependency&gt;
    &lt;dependency&gt;
        &lt;groupId&gt;org.projectlombok&lt;/groupId&gt;
        &lt;artifactId&gt;lombok&lt;/artifactId&gt;
        &lt;optional&gt;true&lt;/optional&gt;
    &lt;/dependency&gt;
&lt;/dependencies&gt;
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>配置文件</p>
<pre><code class="language-properties">server.port=8013
# ?????????
server.servlet.encoding.charset=UTF-8
server.servlet.encoding.enabled=true
server.servlet.encoding.force=true

spring.application.name=saa14-localmcpserver

# mcp server configuration
# ????
spring.ai.mcp.server.type=async
spring.ai.mcp.server.name=customer-define-mcp-server
spring.ai.mcp.server.version=1.0.0
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>配置类</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Configuration
public class McpServerConfig {

    /**
     * 将工具方法暴露给外部的MCP client 调用
     * @param weatherService
     * @return
     */
    @Bean
    public ToolCallbackProvider weatherTools(WeatherService weatherService) {
        return MethodToolCallbackProvider.builder()
                .toolObjects(weatherService)
                .build();
    }
}
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>服务类</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Service
public class WeatherService {

    @Tool(description = "根据城市名称获取天气信息")
    public String getWeather(String location) {
        Map&lt;String, String&gt; map = new HashMap&lt;String, String&gt;();
        map.put("北京", "最近下雨很多");
        map.put("上海", "一直都是多云");
        map.put("深圳", "阴晴不定的");
        return map.getOrDefault(location, "未知城市");
    }
}
</code></pre>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="mcp客户端">MCP客户端</h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p>pom依赖</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">&lt;dependencies&gt;
    &lt;dependency&gt;
        &lt;groupId&gt;org.springframework.boot&lt;/groupId&gt;
        &lt;artifactId&gt;spring-boot-starter-web&lt;/artifactId&gt;
    &lt;/dependency&gt;
    &lt;dependency&gt;
        &lt;groupId&gt;com.alibaba.cloud.ai&lt;/groupId&gt;
        &lt;artifactId&gt;spring-ai-alibaba-starter-dashscope&lt;/artifactId&gt;
    &lt;/dependency&gt;
    &lt;dependency&gt;
        &lt;groupId&gt;org.springframework.ai&lt;/groupId&gt;
        &lt;artifactId&gt;spring-ai-starter-mcp-client&lt;/artifactId&gt;
    &lt;/dependency&gt;
    &lt;dependency&gt;
        &lt;groupId&gt;org.projectlombok&lt;/groupId&gt;
        &lt;artifactId&gt;lombok&lt;/artifactId&gt;
        &lt;optional&gt;true&lt;/optional&gt;
    &lt;/dependency&gt;
&lt;/dependencies&gt;
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>配置文件</p>
<pre><code class="language-properties">server.port=8014
# ?????????
server.servlet.encoding.charset=UTF-8
server.servlet.encoding.enabled=true
server.servlet.encoding.force=true

spring.application.name=saa15-localmcpclient

#springai ????config
spring.ai.dashscope.api-key=${aliQwen-apikey}

# mcp client configuration
spring.ai.mcp.client.type=async
spring.ai.mcp.client.request-timeout=60s
spring.ai.mcp.client.toolcallback.enabled=true
spring.ai.mcp.client.sse.connections.mcp-server1.url=http://localhost:8013
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>配置类</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Configuration
public class SaaLLMConfig {

    private final String DEEPSEEk_MODEL="deepseek-v3";
    private final String QWEN_MODEL="qwen-max";

    // 方式一
    @Value("${spring.ai.dashscope.api-key}")
    private String apiKey;

    // 配置大模型对外暴露的api
    @Bean(name = "deepseekChatModel")
    public ChatModel deepseekChatModel() {
    return DashScopeChatModel.builder()
            // 配置apikey
            .dashScopeApi(DashScopeApi.builder().apiKey(apiKey).build())
            // 配置模型
            .defaultOptions(DashScopeChatOptions.builder().withModel(DEEPSEEk_MODEL).build())
            .build();
    }

    @Bean(name = "qwenChatModel")
    public ChatModel qwenChatModel() {
        return DashScopeChatModel.builder()
                // 配置apikey
                .dashScopeApi(DashScopeApi.builder().apiKey(apiKey).build())
                // 配置模型
                .defaultOptions(DashScopeChatOptions.builder().withModel(QWEN_MODEL).build())
                .build();
    }

    @Bean(name = "deepseekChatClient")
    public ChatClient deepseekChatClient(@Qualifier("deepseekChatModel") ChatModel deepseekChatModel) {
        return ChatClient.builder(deepseekChatModel)
                .build();
    }

    @Bean("qwenChatClient")
    public ChatClient qwenChatClient(@Qualifier("qwenChatModel") ChatModel qwenChatModel, ToolCallbackProvider toolCallbackProvider) {
        return ChatClient.builder(qwenChatModel)
                .defaultToolCallbacks(toolCallbackProvider.getToolCallbacks()) // mcp server端暴露的工具方法
                .build();
    }
}
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>控制器类</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@RestController
public class McpClientController {

    @Resource(name = &amp;quot;qwenChatModel&amp;quot;)
    private ChatModel qwenChatModel;

    @Resource(name = &amp;quot;qwenChatClient&amp;quot;)
    private ChatClient qwenChatClient;

    /**
     * 使用mcp server端暴露的工具方法
     * @param msg
     * @return
     */
    @GetMapping(&amp;quot;/mcpclient/chat&amp;quot;)
    public Flux&amp;lt;String&amp;gt; chat(@RequestParam(name=&amp;quot;msg&amp;quot;,defaultValue = &amp;quot;北京&amp;quot;) String msg) {
        return qwenChatClient.prompt(msg).stream().content();
    }

    /**
     * 不使用mcp server端暴露的工具方法
     * @param msg
     * @return
     */
    @GetMapping(&amp;quot;/mcpclient/chat2&amp;quot;)
    public Flux&amp;lt;String&amp;gt; chat2(@RequestParam(name=&amp;quot;msg&amp;quot;,defaultValue = &amp;quot;北京&amp;quot;) String msg) {
        return qwenChatModel.stream(msg);
    }

}
</code></pre>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="通过mcp调用百度地图">通过MCP调用百度地图</h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p>pom依赖</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">&lt;dependencies&gt;
    &lt;dependency&gt;
        &lt;groupId&gt;org.springframework.boot&lt;/groupId&gt;
        &lt;artifactId&gt;spring-boot-starter-web&lt;/artifactId&gt;
    &lt;/dependency&gt;
    &lt;dependency&gt;
        &lt;groupId&gt;com.alibaba.cloud.ai&lt;/groupId&gt;
        &lt;artifactId&gt;spring-ai-alibaba-starter-dashscope&lt;/artifactId&gt;
    &lt;/dependency&gt;
    &lt;dependency&gt;
        &lt;groupId&gt;org.springframework.ai&lt;/groupId&gt;
        &lt;artifactId&gt;spring-ai-starter-mcp-client&lt;/artifactId&gt;
    &lt;/dependency&gt;
    &lt;dependency&gt;
        &lt;groupId&gt;org.projectlombok&lt;/groupId&gt;
        &lt;artifactId&gt;lombok&lt;/artifactId&gt;
        &lt;optional&gt;true&lt;/optional&gt;
    &lt;/dependency&gt;
&lt;/dependencies&gt;
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>配置文件</p>
<pre><code class="language-properties">server.port=8015
# ?????????
server.servlet.encoding.charset=UTF-8
server.servlet.encoding.enabled=true
server.servlet.encoding.force=true

spring.application.name=saa16-ClientCallBaiduMapMcpServer

#springai ????config
spring.ai.dashscope.api-key=${aliQwen-apikey}

# mcp client configuration
spring.ai.mcp.client.request-timeout=60s
spring.ai.mcp.client.toolcallback.enabled=true
# json5 ???????????json????
spring.ai.mcp.client.stdio.servers-configuration=classpath:mcp-server.json5
</code></pre>
<p>mcp-server.json5文件内容如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
  "mcpServers": {
    "baidu-map": {
      "command": "cmd",
      "args": [
        "/c",
        "npx",
        "-y",
        "@baidumap/mcp-server-baidu-map"
      ],
      "env": {
        "BAIDU_MAP_API_KEY": "1ZGpFxxONtxxzhq3WEd5Z3BnNoB6"
      }
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>配置类</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Configuration
public class SaaLLMConfig {

    private final String QWEN_MODEL="qwen-max";

    // 方式一
    @Value("${spring.ai.dashscope.api-key}")
    private String apiKey;


    @Bean(name = "qwenChatModel")
    public ChatModel qwenChatModel() {
        return DashScopeChatModel.builder()
                // 配置apikey
                .dashScopeApi(DashScopeApi.builder().apiKey(apiKey).build())
                // 配置模型
                .defaultOptions(DashScopeChatOptions.builder().withModel(QWEN_MODEL).build())
                .build();
    }


    @Bean("qwenChatClient")
    public ChatClient qwenChatClient(@Qualifier("qwenChatModel") ChatModel qwenChatModel, ToolCallbackProvider toolCallbackProvider) {
        return ChatClient.builder(qwenChatModel)
                .defaultToolCallbacks(toolCallbackProvider.getToolCallbacks()) // mcp server端暴露的工具方法
                .build();
    }
}
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>控制器类</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@RestController
public class McpClientCallBaiduMcpController {

    @Resource(name = "qwenChatModel")
    private ChatModel qwenChatModel;

    @Resource(name = "qwenChatClient")
    private ChatClient qwenChatClient;

    /**
     * 使用mcp server端暴露的工具方法
     * 可以查询天气，IP归属地、路线规划
     * demo参数：查询北纬39.9042°，东经116.4074°的天气情况
     * demo参数：查询61.149.121.66归属地
     * demo参数：查询从北京到上海的路线规划
     * @param msg
     * @return
     */
    @GetMapping("/mcpclient/chat")
    public Flux&lt;String&gt; chat(@RequestParam(name="msg",defaultValue = "北京") String msg) {
        return qwenChatClient.prompt(msg).stream().content();
    }

}
</code></pre>
</li>
</ol>
